description: Read a file of the postgres source at any commit, branch, tag or date from the code-history index: numbered lines, at most 2000 per call (page with start_line/end_line), byte-exact to git. Says total_lines and complete; binary files return their metadata only.

path.description: Path from the repository root, e.g. src/backend/access/transam/xlog.c

repository.description: Repository; only postgres is in the code-history index for now (the default).

version.description: Commit to read: a SHA or 7+ hex prefix, a branch (master, REL_17_STABLE), a tag (REL_17_0), a major (17, 9.6), a release (17.2), <ref>@YYYY-MM-DD (the branch's last commit by that day), or <ref>~N. Default: the newest release branch's head.

name: read_file
